kitStops: Cologne: Cologne sits on the Rhine river in North Rhine-Westphalia and reaches back to the time of the ancient Roman Empire, when it was founded. | Step inside the Basilica of the Holy Apostles and take in its long history | Visit St. Gereon's Basilica, a beautiful reminder of the city's layered past | Wander to the Basilica of St. Ursula and soak up the atmosphere

Basel: Basel is one of Switzerland's underrated tourist destinations, with a beautiful medieval old town centre and several art museums. | Spend time at the Kunstmuseum Basel surrounded by art | Discover the playful works at the Museum Jean Tinguely | Step inside the Elisabethenkirche in the compact old town

Dubrovnik: A historic walled city on the Adriatic, nicknamed the Pearl of the Adriatic and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. | Pause at Big Onofrio's Fountain | Visit the Rector's Palace | See the Church of Saint Blaise
Slano: A village in southern Croatia with a small harbour in the bay of the same name.
Korcula: A Croatian island in the Adriatic Sea, known for Grk, a white wine produced only on the island.
Bisevo: A Croatian island in the Adriatic Sea.
Hvar: A town revealing one of the largest squares in Dalmatia, with fortifications above grey stone and orange roofs. | Head to Adventure park Hvar Jelsa
Stari Grad: A spot with a quaint fishing harbour and a wide promenade edging the brilliant blue sea. | Explore Grapčeva cave | Try Adventure park Hvar Jelsa

Split: A city in Central Dalmatia built around the Diocletian palace, with Roman walls, squares and temples. | Explore the Basement halls of Diocletian's Palace | Visit Katedrala sv. Duje | Relax at Split city beach
Trogir: A medieval town near Split, a popular day trip within its metropolitan area. | Visit Kaštel Kamerlengo
Sibenik: A coastal town with old churches, gardens and a hilltop fortress. | Visit the Fortress of St. Michael | See Crkva sv. Barbare | Wander Perivoj Roberta Visianija
Vodice: A spot along the Šibenik stretch of coast with churches and quiet gardens. | See Crkva i smostan sv. Frane | Visit Tvrđava sv. Mihovila | Explore Srednjovjekovni vrt sv.Lovre
Zagreb: The capital of Croatia, with a charming medieval old city of cobbled streets. | Visit Zagreb Cathedral | See St. Mark's Square | Climb Lotrščak Tower
